description.ja: 「機動戦士ガンダム ZZ」に登場、ザクの最終発展形として試作されたモビルスーツを立体化しました。胸部と腹部は別パーツ成形で、胸部の可動と上体のひねりの動作が再現可能です。右肩シールドは上下独立可動します。バックパック左右のプロペラントタンクは可動します。指が可動します。銃剣の着脱が可能なビーム・ライフルが付いています。
description.en: A three-dimensional version of the mobile suit that appeared in "Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ" and was prototyped as the final development form of Zaku. The chest and abdomen are molded as separate parts, making it possible to reproduce the movement of the chest and twisting of the upper body. The right shoulder seal can move up and down independently. The propellant tanks on the left and right sides of the backpack are movable. The fingers are movable. Comes with a beam rifle with a detachable bayonet.
